failed_run.failure: The bootstrap runner invoked git merge-base --is-ancestor against the frozen base commit, but actions/checkout used the default shallow depth and the base commit was not present.

authorized_fix.change: Set actions/checkout fetch-depth to 0 so the already frozen base commit is available for the ancestry check.

rerun_authorization: One exact rerun is authorized with full Git history and otherwise identical frozen transport, runtime bundle, task, data, endpoints, thresholds, seeds, gates, and label boundary.
